selection_basis: 20 fixed canonical validation examples, all 20 validation scenario families; no final generative test exposure
test_scope: all 240 held-out authored rows / 30 scenario families; no further prompt or training changes

raw_schema_validity.definition: raw schema and exact original source spans valid / all attempted
raw_schema_validity.criterion: adapted rate at least observed zero-shot validation rate 0.60
raw_schema_validity.rationale: adaptation should preserve the strongest observed structural baseline; adapter validation 0.05 currently fails this criterion

category.definition: all-attempted category agreement, 48 null-category test rows excluded
category.criterion: positive adapted-minus-zero-shot paired family interval lower bound > 0; publish macro-F1 regardless
category.rationale: validation difference 0.0625 vs 0.0 is too small to assume usefulness; compare against category-only classifier separately

entity_grounding.definition: every returned record passes exact Unicode source-span validator; generated bad spans are failures
entity_grounding.criterion: zero structurally unsupported entity spans in accepted records
entity_grounding.rationale: hard API contract; this is not semantic entity correctness; canonical validation has no reference entities, so no entity recall target is calibrated

unnecessary_clarification.definition: valid needs_clarification responses on reference-triaged rows / all reference-triaged rows
unnecessary_clarification.rationale: canonical validation contains zero reference-triaged rows; target cannot be supported; report test denominator and rate, do not invent a threshold

latency.definition: warm single-request p95 on three fixed validation messages, generation+queue+validation
latency.rationale: largest observed validation request duration; provisional interactive lab budget, not an SLA; measure serving with separate warmups

decision: research deployment with visible invalid-output handling; no claim of production readiness
